FAQs

Roofing and Driveway Questions, Answered

What people ask before they ring, answered by Alex and John and the team, with what our customers say.

Quotes and Callouts The Work About Us Where We Work

Quotes and Callouts

How quickly can you come out and quote?

Usually quickly, though it depends on the diary. Customers on Checkatrade say we quoted the same day in Hull and came out the same day to fix a leaking gutter in Brigg. Call 01472 306134 and we'll tell you when we can get to you.

Do you show me the problem before you quote?

Yes. Customers in Scunthorpe and Hull say we took photos to show them the damage and what needed doing, and one Hull customer's quote came from the photographic and physical evidence we gave them. More on roof repairs.

What happens if you find more work once the job starts?

We stop, explain it and agree it with you before carrying on, as our terms set out. In Cleethorpes, a customer says a few extra tiles were needed and were replaced at no extra charge to the original quote.

Can you help with an emergency leak?

Call us on 01472 306134. Checkatrade reviewers describe emergency callouts: in Beverley the leak was repaired within 3 hours of calling, and in Market Rasen we came out the same day after heavy rain got in through a flat roof bay window. See roof repairs.

The Work

How long does a job take?

Most of our jobs take 1 to 3 days. Smaller repairs are often quicker: a customer in Hull says the team arrived at 9am and were finished by half 11.

Will you take on a small job, like one tile?

Yes. Our Checkatrade reviews include refitting a single tile in Immingham, fixing three leaking gutter joints in Lincoln in an hour, and replacing a broken tile in Cleethorpes. See roof repairs and guttering.

Do you clear up after the job?

Yes. A customer in Grimsby says we left the site very tidy and removed all the rubble after taking a chimney down, and one in Scunthorpe says we cleared all the mess up after fitting a new roof.

Do you do flat roofs?

Yes. Alex has completed TuffStuff's training on their Flexiplus and Flexible GRP flat roof systems, and our Checkatrade reviews include a new rubber flat roof in Grimsby. See flat roofs.

What kinds of driveway do you lay?

Resin, block paving and tarmac. We're a Vuba Surfaces registered installer for resin and a Resiblock Registered Contractor for sealing block paving (see our accreditations). More on driveways.

Do you lay patios and paths?

Yes, in slabs and in resin. Our reviews include a slab path, patio and small fence in Grimsby, a resin patio in Bridlington and a patio rebuilt in resin in Beverley. See patios and paths and garden landscaping.

About Us

Who runs Smart Call Contractors?

Alex and John, with a team of 5, from our base in Grimsby. More on our about page.

Are you insured, and is the work guaranteed?

Yes. We hold £5,000,000 public liability insurance, and our work comes with a 10 year guarantee. Ask us what the guarantee covers for your job.

Where can I read your reviews?

On Checkatrade, where we've been members since January 2025 and score 9.9/10 from 143 reviews. We also score 5.0 from 29 reviews on Google and 5/5 from 102 on Bark. Read them on our reviews page.

Where We Work

What areas do you cover?

We're based in Grimsby and cover North and North East Lincolnshire, Hull and East Yorkshire, including Cleethorpes, Scunthorpe, Brigg, Hull and Beverley. See every area we cover.

What are your opening hours?

9am to 5pm. Call 01472 306134, or send us a WhatsApp or a message through the contact form and we'll get back to you.

Still Got a Question?

Ask Alex and John directly. We're open 9am to 5pm.
